minimalsanitized.rationale: ROOT_CAUSE - Exchange rate uses balanceOf() which includes donated tokens. When totalSupply is tiny (e.g., 1 wei), donations massively inflate the rate. Attacker donates to inflate 1 token's collateral value.
Zero-supply branch. Part of same lifecycle invariant as CA1 - not an independent prerequisite. Bootstrap condition context.
Oracle consumer. Post-exploit propagation path that consumes already-manipulated exchange rate. Not a prerequisite.

Redeem function for withdrawing underlying tokens.
